entries.title: Psalms 37:1
segments: A Psalm of David. Do not fret yourself with evil doers; and do not be envious against the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 37:2
segments: For they shall soon wither like the grass; and fade as the green herb.

entries.title: Psalms 37:3
segments: Trust in the LORD, and do good; you shall dwell in the land, and you shall be fed on truth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:4
segments: Delight yourself also in the LORD, and He shall give you the desires of your heart.

entries.title: Psalms 37:5
segments: Roll your way on the LORD; trust also in Him, and He will work.

entries.title: Psalms 37:6
segments: And He shall bring forth your righteousness like the light, and your judgment like the noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 37:7
segments: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; do not fret yourself because of him who prospers in his way, because of him who practices wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 37:8
segments: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; do not fret yourself to do evil.

entries.title: Psalms 37:9
segments: For evildoers shall be cut off; but those who wait on the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:10
segments: [It is] but a little while, and the wicked shall not be; yea, you shall search his place, and he shall not be.

entries.title: Psalms 37:11
segments: But the meek shall inherit the earth, and shall delight themselves in the overflowing of peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:12
segments: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes on him with his teeth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:13
segments: The LORD laughs at him; for He sees that his day is coming.

entries.title: Psalms 37:14
segments: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who walk uprightly.

entries.title: Psalms 37:15
segments: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

entries.title: Psalms 37:16
segments: A little to the righteous [is] better than the riches of many wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 37:17
segments: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the LORD upholds the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 37:18
segments: The LORD knows the days of the upright, and their inheritance shall be forever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:19
segments: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 37:20
segments: But the wicked shall pass, and the enemies of the LORD [shall be] like the beauty of pastures; they are consumed, like smoke they perish.

entries.title: Psalms 37:21
segments: The wicked borrows, and never pays again; but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.

entries.title: Psalms 37:22
segments: For His blessed ones shall inherit the earth; and those cursed by Him shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:23
segments: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD; and He delights in his way.

entries.title: Psalms 37:24
segments: Though he fall, he shall not be cast down; for the LORD upholds his hand.

entries.title: Psalms 37:25
segments: I have been young, and am old; yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, or his seed begging bread.

entries.title: Psalms 37:26
segments: All the day long he deals graciously, and lends; and his seed [is] blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 37:27
segments: Depart from evil and do good; and live forevermore.

entries.title: Psalms 37:28
segments: For the LORD loves judgment and does not forsake His saints; they are kept forever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:29
segments: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell in it forever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:30
segments: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 37:31
segments: The law of his God [is] in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

entries.title: Psalms 37:32
segments: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.

entries.title: Psalms 37:33
segments: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor allow [him] to be found guilty when he is judged.

entries.title: Psalms 37:34
segments: Wait on the LORD, and keep His way, and He shall lift you up to inherit the earth; when the wicked are cut off, you shall see [it].

entries.title: Psalms 37:35
segments: I have seen the wicked ruthless, and spreading himself like a luxuriant native [tree].

entries.title: Psalms 37:36
segments: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he [was] not; and I looked for him, but he could not be found.

entries.title: Psalms 37:37
segments: Watch the perfect and behold the upright one; for the end of [that] man [is] peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:38
segments: But the sinners are destroyed together; the end of the wicked is cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:39
segments: But the salvation of the righteous [is] from the LORD; [He is] their strength in the time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 37:40
segments: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them; He shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in Him.
